'''Jonathan Faust''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 5th at [[July 2001 Moorestown tournament]] on 22 July 2001, according to Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2700">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-23-moorestown-nj-22-jul-01d2700/ moorestown-nj-22-jul-01], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 23 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-23-moorestown-nj-22-jul-01d2700/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
